digest.component_or_area: code-review verdict assembly and sidecar signing
propositions: code-review verdicts never set the provider_provenance key despite sidecar.py reading it, leaving the field absent in all signed verdicts
the real assembly path at code_review_coach and finalize_code_review_verdict must wire provider_provenance from the Pass-2 verify agent step output to the terminal verdict
provider_provenance must be sourced only from the runner result already assembled by capabilities.provenance_for, never recomputed at the verdict site
the degraded/outage path _degraded_code_review_verdict must omit provider_provenance entirely rather than synthesizing it from config
code-review.yaml must wire provider_provenance from an AGENT step (not a scripted op) so runner result outputs are carried verbatim
